title: Paired scan transition
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $G_0,G_1$ each take three optional cell values to an optional cell value, let $st$ be a pair of scan states, and let $ch$ be a finite list of pairs of Boolean symbols. Decode the two coordinate lists of $ch$ into a pair of optional cell values, then apply the scan-state step determined by $G_0$ to the first scan state and by $G_1$ to the second, using that decoded pair as input. The resulting pair of scan states is the paired scan transition.
